reviewed_invariants: The A/A gate runs policy 00 against itself for 50 color-reversed pairs and requires a paired-bootstrap interval containing zero.
The three 64-pair pilot cells use the identical sequential pilot opening set and preserve policy 11 as the only confirmation candidate.
The interaction resamples matching opening indices jointly and cannot select a policy or tune a constant.
The 200-pair confirmation uses the independent lines 201-400 corpus and accepts only when the paired-bootstrap lower 95% Elo bound is positive.
Every phase uses Rodent V1.2 default, Threads=1, GOMAXPROCS=1, Hash=128, OwnBook=false, Move Overhead=100, 10+0.1, and physical CPU masks 0,2,4,6.
Each role is preflighted before games; the supervisor, process witness, legal audit, terminal audit, and retained evidence hashes are mandatory.
The Lean hopper remains running and non-owned CPU use is retained as telemetry without silently invalidating or selecting samples.
No observed result can extend the sample, select another factorial cell, alter a constant, or reuse pilot openings for confirmation.
